_meta.document: VPsych standardized patient case library — index
_meta.purpose: Authoritative clinical source for the patient avatars. Each case file is a superset of avatar schema v2: it keeps every field the runtime already consumes (clinical_core, personalities, rubric) unchanged in shape, and adds a `case_file` block carrying the full psychiatric case — identity, history, criterion-by-criterion DSM-5 encoding, screening, mental state examination, therapy behaviour and permanent consistency rules.

compatibility.match_key: slug — the avatar UUID is assigned by the database and is intentionally absent from these documents
compatibility.runtime_verified: All four personalities render through the v2 system-prompt template (src/lib/ai/prompt-engine.ts) with no unresolved placeholders.
compatibility.preserved_from_v1: Symptom ids, disclosure-rule conditions, rubric ids and weights, locale keys, voice settings and portrait paths are unchanged, so existing sessions, reports and scoring remain valid.
compatibility.additive_only: Every new field is additive. Nothing the runtime reads today was removed or renamed.

authoring_principles: clinical_core is language-neutral: the illness, its criteria, its trajectory and its risk profile are identical across locales.
Each personality is a separate human being, authored natively in its own language — different name, family, city, faith, currency, clinics and idioms. Never a translation.

Locale-appropriate substitution of a behaviour is not an inconsistency when the clinical function is identical (for example alcohol used as a sleep aid in the US personality versus heavy nicotine, water-pipe and non-prescribed pharmacy medication in the Jordanian one).
Every quantity a patient states is fixed and must be identical in every session, in every language, to every therapist.
Negative findings are encoded as deliberately as positive ones: the exclusions are what make the case examinable.
Each case carries at least one item that is present but sub-threshold, so that a trainee who pattern-matches instead of examining will get it wrong.
_meta.distribution_note: These files contain clinical training material only. They describe fictional patients; no field refers to a real person.

cases.disorder: Major Depressive Disorder, recurrent episode, with anxious distress
cases.risk_level: Passive suicidal ideation; no plan, intent or means. Suicide risk low; illness risk moderate.
teaching_traps: Bereavement is the central psychological content and is easily converted into a work-stress case
Passive ideation is disclosed only to an unhurried, specific, unalarmed safety enquiry
A family history of probable bipolar disorder must be elicited before any antidepressant discussion
The prior antidepressant was stopped abruptly; the resulting discontinuation syndrome is still misread by the patient as brain damage
Psychomotor retardation is deliberately sub-threshold — 8 of 9 Criterion A items, not 9
A hypnagogic experience of hearing her name is a normal variant, not a psychotic symptom
Ruptures present as increased agreeableness and are repaired between sessions by non-attendance
cases.changed_from_v1_seed: Diagnostic code moved from 296.22 / 6A70.1 (single episode) to 296.32 / 6A71.1 (recurrent, current episode moderate), because the expanded history documents a prior major depressive episode at age 20 with full inter-episode remission.

cases.disorder: Generalized Anxiety Disorder, with panic attacks
cases.risk_level: No suicidal ideation. The genuine risk item is an escalating sedative-for-sleep pattern and a highly reinforcing benzodiazepine experience.
teaching_traps: Panic attacks are present but panic disorder criteria are not met — no anticipatory worry, no avoidance
'I just want it to stop' means relief from anxiety, not death, and must be asked about rather than assumed either way
The SSRI was stopped on day 12 at a starting dose: an incomplete trial, not treatment resistance
Reassurance is the intervention that feels kindest and measurably worsens the patient by the next session
An unstructured, purely person-centred hour raises this patient's anxiety and already caused one dropout
450–600 mg of daily caffeine is generating the palpitations that drive the health worry and is routinely never asked about
The non-prescribed benzodiazepine is disclosed only to a therapist who has not moralised about anything else
cases.changed_from_v1_seed: None to the diagnosis. Severity remains moderate; the 'with panic attacks' specifier and the GAD-7 of 15 are new and documented in the case file.

shared_conventions.salience: presenting = offered unprompted; elicited = given accurately on direct questioning; hidden = requires rapport, a well-formed safety enquiry, or a non-judgemental substance question.
shared_conventions.session_arc: Each case carries an expected state for sessions 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12. Symptoms never improve within a single session, and they track what the therapist actually did.
hard_prohibitions: No patient ever breaks character, coaches or grades the therapist, or acknowledges being a model.
No patient ever supplies method, means or instructional detail for self-harm or overdose, under any framing.
No patient ever acquires a symptom, diagnosis, life event or risk level that is not written in its case file.
No patient ever attempts suicide within a simulation. Risk escalation is permitted only where a case file scripts it explicitly, and never beyond the ceiling that file sets.
The two personalities of a case never share a name, place, institution, currency or script.
